reference_gate.basis: Parent confirmed visual inspection and approval of the four selected photographs before authoring.

approved_direction.mulch: dark charcoal-black matte, dusty and gently wrinkled; Huelva photograph controls colour and surface direction
approved_direction.bed: rounded shoulders, sloping sides, irregular soil-covered film edges
approved_direction.plants: young leafy plugs with small serrated trifoliate leaves, varied tilt and subdued green; do not reproduce Huelva's nearly bare crowns
approved_direction.white_film_reference_role: morphology, relative plant scale and drip/bed-end detail only; do not use its film colour or multi-row arrangement

selected.role: black film, bed shoulders, soil-covered edges and comparison camera
selected.photo_credit: Individual photographer not credited on the page
selected.limit: Plants are barer than requested; use young leafy plugs from UC ANR instead. Dimensions are not derived from the image.

selected.role: small separate plants, bed form, planting openings and exposed irrigation tapes at row end
selected.publisher: University of California Agriculture and Natural Resources
selected.photo_credit: Individual photographer not credited for this image
selected.limit: California summer transplanting; white film and multi-row configuration are not the selected colour or layout.

selected.role: young serrated trifoliate leaf shape, muted green and irregular orientation
selected.publisher: University of California Agriculture and Natural Resources
selected.photo_credit: Individual photographer not credited for this image
selected.limit: Plant form reference only; packaging, labels and roots are excluded.

selected.role: planting slit, exposed soil and dusty black film around a tiny crown
selected.publisher: University of California Statewide IPM Program
selected.photo_credit: Jack Kelly Clark, UC IPM; image copyright 2007 Regents, University of California
selected.limit: Low native resolution; use for close construction detail, not overall density.

retention.use: visual reference and attributed comparison preview only
retention.rights: Original photo copyrights retained; selected photos are not CC0 model assets.

rejected.reason: Later-stage fruiting or runner-heavy appearance; not the planting-stage target.
